Requirement: The braking system shall stop the train within 250 m from 80 km/h on dry rails, verified by test procedure TP-14.
The supplier shall deliver the maintenance manual in PDF format before the Factory Acceptance Test.
The cabinet shall weigh 45 kg plus or minus 2 kg, measured with a calibrated scale.
The door shall open when the train speed is 0 km/h and the platform side is detected by sensor S12.
The system should respond rapidly and be user-friendly.
The equipment shall be maximally modular and maintained as quickly as possible.
The interface shall be robust and handle errors appropriately, if necessary.
The supplier shall provide adequate documentation and support as required.
